messages:
maria: Heads-up: were running a short solution-sprint to produce a field-ready one-pager + two launch posts + a webinar blurb for deploy-mode enterprise messaging (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Goal: actionable copy + routing matrix for inbound. Timeline: first drafts tomorrow morning.
aj: Got it. Ill own the one-pager and the product-led social post. Can someone in eng confirm conservative SLA phrasing (headline only) and a benchmark stat we can cite? Prefer a single-line p95/p99 and a cautious cost-savings stat.
tom: Field input: please include a 3-column compare row (Risk | SLA tier headline | Recommended next step). Also want a 1-sentence intake workflow for Dedicated evals.
lisa: I can grab a short ops blurb and a tiny autoscale snippet for the ops appendix. Note: latency varies a lot by model & seq len  include a footnote. Ops suggested headline: "Enterprise SLA tiers (Standard: 99.5% / Business: 99.9% / Premium: 99.95%)" — feel free to soften.
kevin: Ill draft two social variants: (A) Product-led metric + webinar CTA for organic; (B) Exec-level compliance & SLA focus for LinkedIn paid. Also will outline a short paid-media uplift test (A/B creative + landing page CTA).
maria: For inbound routing matrix: high-intent inbound -> Sales Ops (priority routing); compliance/legal-heavy -> Security review -> Solutions Eng; trial signups -> SDR nurture. Field wants direct link for Dedicated eval intake.
aj: Draft CTAs to test on landing: 1) Request Dedicated Eval (primary) 2) Book a Pilot (for larger proofs) 3) Start Free Trial (self-serve). Keep trial visible but make field CTA the main button on paid assets.
tom: Intake timeline for one-pager: Form -> Security checklist -> Sizing call -> 2-week pilot (if approved) -> post-pilot SLA decision. Condensed to: "Form → Security review → Sizing call → 2-week pilot → decision (2–6w)."
lisa: Ops snippet for appendix (put in code block on a separate ops slide):
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 24
  target_utilization: 0.7
```
kevin: Sample product social copy (short): "Ship reliable LLM features where you need them  hosted, dedicated, or in your network  with enterprise SLA options and security controls. Join our webinar: https://events.redwood/deploy-mode-pulse"
kevin: Sample exec LinkedIn (longer): "As teams build regulated AI experiences, deployment choice matters. Redwood Inference offers hosted, reserved, and private deployments with clear SLA tiers and security integrations so teams can focus on product. Request a Dedicated Eval to see capacity & compliance options."
aj: For the benchmark pullout, ops gave a conservative band: "Typical mid-size chat workload (50k tokens/day) — observed up to ~27% unit-cost reduction using batching + KV caching; results vary by model and prompt shape." We'll footnote variability.
maria: Nice. Add a short section in the one-pager on graceful degradation: model-fallbacks, region routing, and automatic spillover to Dedicated/hosted variants. One-sentence incident response note: "We maintain incident runbooks and automated fallbacks to minimize customer impact."
tom: For the compare row examples (single-line each):
- Hosted: "Low-friction; SLA: Standard; Buyer: product teams; Next step: Start Free Trial"
- Dedicated: "Predictable capacity & isolation; SLA: Business; Buyer: mid/enterprise; Next step: Request Dedicated Eval"
- Private: "Regulated & air-gapped options; SLA: Premium; Buyer: regulated enterprise; Next step: Contact Sales / Book Pilot"
aj: I'll assemble the one-pager sections: TL;DR, 3-line mode-at-a-glance, security + controls bullets, SLA snapshot (headline tiers), benchmark pullout, field intake + routing matrix, CTAs, webinar blurb, FAQ.
lisa: Ops asks we include a short footnote under SLA: "Latency and throughput depend on model family, sequence length, and workload shape. Reported p95/p99 are indicative."
\eol: oh small nit: please keep the one-pager to a single page (3-column layout ok).
kevin: Paid media test plan: creative A (metric-led) -> LP with Request Dedicated Eval; creative B (compliance-led) -> LP with Contact Sales; measure form rate + MQL conversion. Add small UTM tags.
maria: Webinar blurb for the one-pager (short): "Webinar: Deployment Modes for Regulated Apps — practical guidance for choosing hosted, dedicated, or private deployments. Register: https://events.redwood/deploy-mode-pulse (2026-11-17 10:00 PT)"
aj: I'll drop first draft files into the drive by 09:00 PT tomorrow. Can we review at 09:30? Please add reactions when copy is uploaded.
kevin: Will have social drafts and paid plan by EOD today.
lisa: Ops will upload a very small CSV with p95/p99 samples and the bench note for the footnote. Link will be added to the one-pager.
tom: Field will prepare a 3-line intake FAQ that we can paste into the one-pager.
maria: Sounds good. Final review tomorrow 09:30 PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
